name: Frontage — your website in one click
description: Turn any business page into a finished, live website in a single click.

//: Every http(s) page, not a list of Google domains.
The list existed because the content scripts were DOM parsers with
selectors for Google Search and Google Maps, and there was nothing to
run anywhere else. Nothing here parses now — it photographs the page,
reads its text, and collects its links — so it works the same on
JustDial, Yelp, a directory or the business's own site, and there is no
reason to keep a list of domains up to date.
